_comment: Thin dispatch commands generated into every plugin channel by scripts/build-agent-skills.mjs. Authored HERE because a command description is menu copy — a short imperative row someone scans — and the subcommand table in SKILL.md is written to explain a routing entry, which reads badly in a picker. Derived descriptions were tried and were worse than these (2026-08-28). Every key must also exist as a row in SKILL.md's subcommand table; the build fails otherwise, so a rename cannot silently orphan a command. `build` is absent on purpose: it is the dispatcher skill itself.
